content: maxmind npm (v5.0.6, MIT, github.com/runk/node-maxmind, 757k weekly downloads, no postinstall) exposes maxmind.open<T>(path) or new Reader<T>(buffer) against any MMDB-format file (works with DB-IP's mmdb, same spec). lookup.get(ip) returns typed CountryResponse|CityResponse|null; getWithPrefixLength(ip) returns [result, prefixLength]. Handles IPv4/IPv6, returns null for unresolvable/private/reserved ranges (must be mapped to 'Unbekannt' per D-04, not skipped).
